# app-kit collaboration

Agentic-kit adopts app-kit's guidance for presentation ownership, not a mandatory
UI runtime or dependency. The [backendless workbench experiment](../prototypes/governed-workbench/README.md)
now renders synthetic interactions; production runtime and public component acceptance remain open.
Agentic-kit owns evidence/decision/approval semantics. Consumers own identity,
routes, storage and effects. app-kit owns reusable visual/accessibility recipes.

## Prose and HITL priority refresh, 2026-10-23

Reaffirmed 2026-10-24: 0038 remains the priority while the bounded command-reader
slice is qualified. It supplies controlled evidence acquisition, not workbench
completion or a reason to finish a general command platform before PX tasks.
Today's exact `approval`/`go-web` query and `work.approval` lookup returned the same
catalog/capability revisions below. `editor`/`react-web` returned no items in that
bounded query, and guarded all-scope approval quality remained empty/untracked.
Guidance still lacks its kit root. The existing three prepared packets and their
runtime/accessibility/attended-task gates remain open; no new ledger or UI claim.

Owner emphasis makes prose as code and HITLMAN the anchor experiences, decision
[0038](intent/decisions/0038-prose-and-hitl-anchor-the-uplift.md).
[PX-01..12](designs/agentic-engineering/prose-hitl-priority.md) is the joint task and
acceptance contract. Existing PH/HW/WB semantics remain authoritative. A separately
admitted local UI task need not wait for two independent adapter consumers; permanent
shared app-kit components still retain their layer-specific promotion requirements.

Refreshed MCP guidance, intent, exact capability and all-scope quality metadata.
Guidance still reports its kit-root configuration unavailable; current maintainer
intent and existing guides supply the fallback. No registration or global settings changed.

- Exact query `approval` returned `work.approval`, available `go-web`/L3b, at the
  catalog and capability revisions recorded below. Its states remain pending/review
  and its proof names a package test. It does not supply the complete workbench,
  authorization, persistence, publication or remote reconciliation.
- Guarded all-scope quality lookup returned empty/untracked at the same inventory
  revision. This is an authored-coverage gap, not proof of ready UI or an observed bug.
- Query `editor` returned only `recipe.styleguide.local` in that bounded result,
  not a prose editor contract. `client-editor-island` guidance describes a private
  React/Tiptap lifecycle specimen, explicitly not a public editor API or save backend.
  Do not infer global catalog absence, public availability or an appropriate runtime
  from those results. Select the actual app profile and complete reference at admission.
- App-kit checkout observed at `2b7e9136`; the MCP catalog is an embedded snapshot,
  not evidence that every current checkout change is loaded or consumer tested.

**Prepared return, not upstream delivery:** AK-HITL-01 owns the ordered queue,
clarification and exact proposal/recovery view; AK-PROSE-01 owns node selection,
source/criteria inspector and revision/variant comparison; AK-EVIDENCE-01 owns
honest support/freshness/coverage/disclosure states. Use synthetic PX fixtures and
the existing contribution-loop process. App-kit should receive reusable interaction
and accessibility checks; agentic-specific policy, evidence truth and graph behavior
remain local. One useful task can return as an experimental specimen first.

Required consumer proof includes actual keyboard/narrow/theme/200%-zoom tasks,
relevant screen-reader/IME/clipboard behavior, focus/draft/history across expansion,
stale/error/denied/reconciliation states, lifecycle/CSS integration and predeclared
human-effort/performance bars. A prototype, screenshot or static source check cannot
satisfy those gates. No new renderer, app-kit source change, upstream acceptance,
browser run or UI quality claim follows from this discovery/planning refresh.

Next action: admit one bounded source-correction/review task with named app and kit
owners; refresh exact metadata and selected reference; preserve failed receipts;
return the smallest reusable fix/specimen; retest the originating app before promotion.
Review by 2026-11-21 or next release. Detailed ownership and delivery fields remain
in the packets below; this priority creates no competing contribution ledger.

## Prepared interaction contributions

The interaction packets below remain **deferred upstream delivery, local specification**.
The separate prototype tooling return is recorded below.
No licensed asset is copied here. These are not confirmed shared defects.

| ID | Originating task and proposed return | Evidence / smallest owning layer | Next action / revisit |
|---|---|---|---|
| AK-HITL-01 | Resolve evidence conflicts and approve exact proposals with minimal human effort | [Human workbench](designs/agentic-engineering/human-workbench.md), HW-01..14; experimental recipe for ordered queue, exact preview, evidence disclosure, expiry/reconciliation and accessible status | W3 selects a complete visual reference and supplies synthetic browser/keyboard/narrow/error fixtures; app-kit reviews recipe boundary before a permanent API |
| AK-PROSE-01 | Inspect sentence/paragraph/section/document evidence and compare generated variants | [Prose harness](designs/agentic-engineering/prose-harness.md), PH cases; reusable node selection/source panel/diff presentation, app retains graph and policy | Build one consumer task; return independent accessibility/selection/diff tests, actual revision and retained failures; measure task effort before promotion |
| AK-EVIDENCE-01 | Show missing/conflicting/stale/denied evidence without misleading confidence or readiness | [Evidence-learning](designs/agentic-engineering/evidence-learning.md), EL-A01..14; portable status/coverage presentation and source-linked dashboard specimen | Return a bounded specimen with truthful units/denominators/freshness, keyboard and non-color states; no universal confidence widget |

For each packet, originating app and kit maintainer own the reproduction;
app-kit's maintainer decides the owning layer. Permanent L3b/L4 components retain
app-kit's two-consumer, Gallery, upgrade-note and accessibility bars. A useful
one-app interaction can return as an experimental specimen first.
